poll.label: Pollution · planar road tracer · 2 m · arbitrary units

flood.label: Flooding · measured terrain core · 4 m grid

limits: Controlled scenarios, not observed weather or live traffic.
Traffic: seeded passenger-car demand and inferred signal timings; flat bridge/tunnel elevations.
© OpenStreetMap contributors; Overture Maps Foundation. Heights and architectural detail include estimates.
UAV stations are demonstration sites; canopy and real-world landing access are unverified. Aircraft share paths without fleet collision scheduling.
Traffic uses synthetic demand and inferred junctions with explicit temporary model closures, not observed road closures or measured flows.
Traffic replay covers actual simulation seconds 1–1200; default starts at 600 s. Environmental fields and UAV clocks remain independent.
Traffic has 3 recorded junction collision events and 0 teleports; intersection behaviour remains unvalidated.
Wind model steps are not calibrated physical time; each scenario uses an independent clock. Overlay shows the selected final independent field frames.
Temperature remains the earlier 32 m controlled result forced by the earlier wind; it has not been recomputed from the new inferred wind.
Pollution is a 2-D conservative passive tracer with arbitrary uniform road emissions, not a calibrated pollutant forecast.
Flooding uses measured EA terrain only within the core; blank cells have no valid model result, not zero hazard. Depth is shown on a flat display plane, not surveyed 3-D flood surface.
Streamline particles follow SouthKen 60× visual advection, not real-time physical trajectories.
Wind uses a 1 m-trained surrogate directly on 4 m cells, with interpreted dt scaled 4× to 100 s. This is a user-selected scale-transfer assumption, not validated physical similarity.
Wind records all 100 model steps; default sample height is 2 m. Numerical ground is at -2 m; vertical domain extends to 252 m.
Pollution remains the independent027 experiment; it has not been recalculated from wind029.
